homepage_url_justification: Project homepage is the GitLab project https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl , also named by DESCRIPTION URL alongside the CRAN page https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rurl . The former pkgdown site (bart-turczynski.github.io/rurl) was retired when the GitHub account hosting it was suspended; a replacement documentation site is tracked separately.
sites_https_justification: All project sites are served over HTTPS: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl and https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rurl .
description_good_justification: DESCRIPTION and README provide a clear, succinct description of what rurl does: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl#readme
interact_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains how to interact with and contribute to the project: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the requirements for acceptable contributions (tests, passing lint via the .lintr style config, and the verify CI gate): https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
license_location_justification: LICENSE is at the repository top level: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/LICENSE
floss_license_osi_justification: MIT is an OSI-approved open source license: https://opensource.org/license/mit
documentation_basics_justification: Basic documentation ships in the README and in the package vignettes, which CRAN renders: https://CRAN.R-project.org/web/packages/rurl/vignettes/getting-started.html .
documentation_interface_justification: Every exported function is documented with roxygen2 man pages, published by CRAN as the reference manual: https://CRAN.R-project.org/web/packages/rurl/rurl.pdf .
repo_track_justification: All changes are tracked in git: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/commits/main
repo_interim_justification: Interim development commits are publicly available between releases: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/commits/main .
repo_distributed_justification: Uses git, a distributed version control system: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl
version_unique_justification: Each release carries a unique version (DESCRIPTION Version; CRAN enforces uniqueness): https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rurl
version_semver_justification: Uses semantic-style x.y.z versioning; releases visible at https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/releases
version_tags_justification: Releases are tagged in git: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/tags . CRAN is the authoritative record of what shipped (https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rurl); tagging has historically been sparse and some released versions were never tagged.
release_notes_justification: NEWS.md documents user-facing changes for each release: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/NEWS.md
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities have been fixed to date; NEWS.md records all changes: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/NEWS.md
report_tracker_justification: GitLab Issues serve as the bug tracker: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/work_items .
report_process_justification: Users submit bug reports through the GitLab issue tracker: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/work_items , which DESCRIPTION names as BugReports.
report_responses_justification: Maintainer responds to issue reports on the tracker: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/work_items
enhancement_responses_justification: Maintainer responds to enhancement requests on the tracker: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/work_items
report_archive_justification: GitLab Issues provide a publicly available, searchable archive of reports and responses: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/work_items/?state=all .
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: The vulnerability-reporting process is published in the security policy: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/SECURITY.md . Reports go to the maintainer by email, with a confidential GitLab issue as a documented alternative.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Two confidential channels are documented in SECURITY.md (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/SECURITY.md): email to the maintainer, and a GitLab issue submitted with the "This issue is confidential" box ticked, which is visible only to project members.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: SECURITY.md commits to acknowledging reports within 7 days and coordinating a fix and disclosure: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: Builds with the standard R toolchain (R CMD build / INSTALL, devtools): https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl
build_common_tools_justification: Uses the standard, widely available R build tooling.
build_floss_tools_justification: R and its toolchain are free/open source software: https://www.r-project.org/
test_invocation_justification: Tests run via devtools::test() and as part of R CMD check.
test_most_justification: Coverage is measured with covr and rendered locally by tools/coverage-report.R (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/tools/coverage-report.R). Coverage was previously uploaded to Codecov from a GitHub Actions workflow; that upload stopped when the account hosting it was suspended, so the Codecov project reports a frozen figure and is no longer cited here.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests for new features and bug fixes: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: New functionality ships with tests, enforced in review.
tests_documented_added_justification: The test-addition policy is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: Warnings are surfaced by R CMD check and lintr, run by tools/verify.R (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/tools/verify.R), the project's blocking verification gate. It is installed as a pre-push hook, so it runs before any push lands.
warnings_fixed_justification: Warnings are treated as errors and fixed; R CMD check is kept clean.
warnings_strict_justification: tools/verify.R sets LINTR_ERROR_ON_LINT=true, so any lint fails the gate and blocks the push: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/tools/verify.R .
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies secure design principles; rurl defensively parses untrusted URL input.
know_common_errors_justification: The maintainer is aware of common URL/IDNA parsing pitfalls and tolerates malformed input safely.
crypto_password_storage_justification: rurl stores no passwords or credentials.
crypto_random_justification: rurl does not generate security-sensitive random values.
crypto_used_network_justification: rurl is a string/URL library and does not itself make network connections.
crypto_tls12_justification: rurl does not establish network connections.
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: rurl does not establish network connections.
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: rurl does not establish network connections.
delivery_mitm_justification: Distributed via CRAN and GitLab over HTTPS; CRAN publishes per-package checksums: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rurl .
delivery_unsigned_justification: All distribution downloads are served over HTTPS (CRAN, GitLab): https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=rurl .
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No outstanding known vulnerabilities; tracker at https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/work_items
static_analysis_justification: lintr runs a full-package lint (its linter set mirrors goodpractice::gp()) as a blocking step of tools/verify.R: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/tools/verify.R . The .lintr header documents every intentional deviation.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: R CMD check plus lintr cover common defect classes; dependency vulnerabilities are audited against the OSV database (osv.dev) via rosv. Both are run by the maintainer against the gate described in https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/tools/verify.R .
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Static-analysis findings are addressed before merge.
static_analysis_often_justification: lintr runs on every push, not merely every release: tools/verify.R is installed as a pre-push hook via pre-commit, so the full-package lint is a precondition of pushing. See https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/tools/verify.R .
dynamic_analysis_justification: NOT CURRENTLY MET. Dynamic analysis under sanitizers was provided by an rhub workflow running R CMD check on the clang-ASAN/UBSAN and valgrind containers. That workflow ran on GitHub Actions, and the account hosting it is suspended, so it no longer runs. The testthat suite still executes on every push via tools/verify.R (https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/tools/verify.R), and tools/local-ci.sh reproduces the CI jobs in the CI container against a clean clone, but neither enables the memory or undefined-behavior sanitizers. Reported unmet rather than left as a claim about a runner that no longer exists.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: rurl is a pure-R package with no compiled code of its own (no src/ directory), so it contains no memory-unsafe C/C++ code to fuzz; the ASAN/valgrind runs still cover its compiled dependencies.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: rurl's automated test suite uses testthat, whose expectations (expect_*) are assertions checked at runtime on every gate run: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/tree/main/tests/testthat . The suite is a blocking step of tools/verify.R and therefore runs before every push.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Any issues surfaced by the sanitizer or valgrind runs are fixed before release.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: NOT CURRENTLY MET. Continuous integration ran on GitHub Actions (verify.yml) until the account hosting it was suspended. A GitLab pipeline is configured at https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/blob/main/.gitlab-ci.yml but is deliberately paused: the free-tier compute allowance is exhausted, so the workflow block admits only hand-started web pipelines and every other pipeline would fail with ci_quota_exceeded. Verification is meanwhile local and mandatory, not optional: tools/verify.R reproduces CI's fast gate and is installed as a pre-push hook, and tools/local-ci.sh runs the CI jobs in the CI image against a clean clone. The pause lifts when the allowance resets; this criterion returns to met then.
discussion_justification: GitLab Issues provide a public forum for project discussion: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/work_items .
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials are committed to the repository; Socket and FOSSA scan the repo: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl
english_justification: Documentation and issue-tracker interaction are conducted in English (Language: en-US): https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl#readme
hardening_justification: Hardening mechanisms (e.g. HTTP security headers) apply to web applications; rurl is an R library.
sites_password_security_justification: Project sites (GitLab, CRAN) manage their own authentication; rurl operates no site with user passwords.
maintained_justification: Actively maintained: recent CRAN releases, frequent commits, and responsive issue handling: https://gitlab.com/bart-turczynski/rurl/-/commits/main
